text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77.5k with modest gains while Ethereum is slightly down, suggesting a mild divergence favoring the larger asset as its dominance edges toward 59%. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 57 but has retreated 14 points over the past week, indicating some cooling momentum despite broad sentiment remaining optimistic. Volume of $61B is moderate—neither exceptionally strong nor weak—which aligns with a consolidating market that lacks clear directional conviction.
